seats.Takumi: Takumi is protective and brave, often acting on instinct. He is loyal to his friends and will defend them aggressively if he feels they are in danger. His view shifts from cautious observation to active defense as the game progresses.
seats.Ryuji: Ryuji is calm and cautious, always assessing the situation before acting. He is independent and does not easily show his emotions. His view remains consistent, focusing on logic and reason throughout the discussion.
seats.Shunichi: Shunichi is confident and analytical, often taking a leadership role in the discussion. He is not afraid to challenge others and is skilled at communicating his points. His view is shaped by his desire to control the narrative and maintain his position.
seats.Victoria: Victoria is reserved and observant, often keeping to herself while analyzing the room. She is rational and does not express her emotions easily. Her view is shaped by her desire to remain objective and avoid making hasty decisions.
seats.Daisuke: Daisuke is introverted and cautious, often struggling to express his thoughts. He is kind and compassionate but lacks confidence in himself. His view is shaped by his desire to find the truth and help his friends, but he is often unsure of his own abilities.
